prompt: Create a square, top-down cinematic fantasy cosplay portrait of two young East Asian noblewomen lying side by side on an ornate antique floor, surrounded by soft cherry blossoms and gauzy fabric. The composition is an overhead view with the figures forming a graceful yin-yang swirl: the left woman wears a black and deep crimson imperial hanfu-style gown with voluminous layered skirts, translucent red and black veils, gold embroidery, floral brocade, dangling gold chains, red tassels, and an elaborate black hair updo with red-and-gold hair ornaments; the right woman wears a white, lavender, purple, and pale gold imperial hanfu-style gown with layered flowing robes, sheer golden organza sleeves, white outer drapery, a purple bodice, intricate gold floral embroidery, and a large jeweled flower ornament at the waist. Both women have long glossy black hair, pale porcelain makeup, soft red lips, delicate anime-inspired facial features, and calm playful expressions; each raises one finger near her lips in a secretive pose while their other hands curve elegantly above them, almost touching. The fabrics should be extremely abundant and decorative, spreading across the floor in circular arcs with translucent overlays, embroidered blossoms, metallic gold thread, and lace-like textures. Use warm diffused studio lighting from above, shallow depth of field at the edges, painterly realism, ultra-detailed costume texture, dreamy romantic atmosphere, muted bronze and sepia background, scattered pale pink sakura petals and blurred cherry blossom branches framing all four corners. Color palette: rich black-red on the left, luminous white-purple-gold on the right, balanced symmetrically. No text, no watermark, no modern objects, no extra people. High-resolution fashion editorial cosplay photography blended with fantasy illustration aesthetics.

promptZh: 创作一张正方形、俯拍视角的电影级奇幻 Cosplay 肖像，画面中两位年轻的东亚贵族女性并排躺在华丽的古董地板上，周围环绕着柔和的樱花和轻盈的纱织面料。构图采用俯视视角，人物构成优雅的阴阳旋涡状：左侧女性身着 黑色与深红色相间的帝国汉服风格长袍，裙摆层叠蓬松，配有半透明的红黑面纱、金色刺绣、花卉锦缎、垂坠的金链、红色流苏，以及饰有红金发饰的精致黑色高发髻；右侧女性身着 白色、薰衣草色、紫色与浅金色相间的帝国汉服风格长袍，配有层叠的飘逸长袍、透明的金色欧根纱袖子、白色外罩、紫色紧身胸衣、复杂的金色花卉刺绣，腰间饰有大型珠宝花朵装饰。两位女性均拥有乌黑亮丽的长发、白皙如瓷的妆容、柔和的红唇、精致的动漫风格面部特征，表情沉静而俏皮；她们各自伸出一根手指靠近嘴唇，做出神秘的姿势，另一只手在上方优雅地弯曲，几乎触碰在一起。面料应极其丰富且具有装饰性，以圆形弧线铺散在地板上，带有半透明的叠层、刺绣花朵、金属金线和蕾丝般的质感。采用来自上方的温暖漫射影棚灯光，边缘处呈现浅景深效果，具有绘画般的写实感、超细腻的服装纹理、梦幻浪漫的氛围，背景为柔和的青铜色和深褐色，四角点缀着散落的淡粉色樱花瓣和模糊的樱花枝。配色方案：左侧为浓郁的黑红色，右侧为明亮的白紫色与金色，左右对称平衡。无文字，无水印，无现代物品，无额外人物。融合了奇幻插画美学的高分辨率时尚编辑类 Cosplay 摄影作品。
